key_insight: SceneBloom combines visual layout generation with geometry-aware 3D compilation to produce realistic, diverse indoor scenes for embodied learning.
engineering_relevance: Simulation-ready layouts can improve object-navigation transfer to real environments while reducing reliance on real training scans.
method: Sample furniture arrangements within functional zones using hierarchical diffusion priors.
Extract spatial relations from proposals to guide contract-based 3D compilation.
Fit geometry and correct object poses locally.
evidence_signal: Across five room types, SceneBloom reports the best visual quality and physical stability among compared methods, no detected mesh collisions or out-of-bounds objects, and higher held-out real-scan navigation success than training on an equal number of real scans.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify performance gains or compilation costs, leaving practical scalability uncertain.
paper_title: SceneBloom: Agentic Indoor Environment Generation with Realistic and Diverse Layouts for Embodied Learning
